title: geoforb2bspecs
claim: AI engines recommend B2B suppliers using public technical specifications rather than brand marketing copy.
hook: AI search ignores your ad copy.

evidence.detail: A 3-step technical content audit for B2B generative search readiness: un-gating specs, HTML table structuring, and third-party registry verification.

reel_script.onscreen: AI search ignores your ad copy.
reel_script.voiceover: AI search ignores your ad copy. When a B2B procurement team asks AI to shortlist industrial suppliers, it skips brand fluff.
reel_script.direction: Clean typography over dark grey background.

reel_script.voiceover: Generative engines crawl technical data sheets, trade journals, and regulatory filings to build vendor lists.
reel_script.direction: Diagram showing data extraction from unstructured documents.

reel_script.onscreen: Gated PDFs hide you from AI.
reel_script.voiceover: If your technical specs sit behind lead forms or inside scanned PDFs, LLM bots cannot read them. You vanish before human evaluation begins.
Here is a three-point checklist to ensure your technical product data is visible to AI search engines.
First, un-gate your primary product data sheets so search crawlers can index exact tolerances, grades, and operating limits.
Second, render specifications in structured HTML tables rather than hiding them inside flat images or locked downloads.
Third, ensure industry trade registries and compliance filings carry accurate model numbers and certifications.

items.label: 1. Un-gate Specs
items.detail: Allow LLMs to index product data

reel_script.onscreen: SEO ranks pages. GEO ranks specs.
reel_script.voiceover: In B2B, visibility is no longer about page rank. SEO ranks pages; GEO ranks specs.

caption:
AI search ignores your ad copy.

In generative engine optimisation for B2B, LLMs build shortlists from technical documentation, not brand campaigns.

When a procurement committee uses AI to identify industrial suppliers, the engine prioritises structured spec sheets, trade registry data, and compliance filings.

If your technical documentation is buried behind lead-capture gates or flattened into unreadable images, your brand simply does not exist in the answer.

Marketing teams spend months polishing value propositions while ignoring the raw product data machines actually read.

If the machine cannot verify your specifications, no amount of positioning copy will get you onto the shortlist.

Send this to the marketer managing your web content and technical documentation.
